title: Fig and the Black Box
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4 longer-word practice, 54-sound stage (bl, br, cl, cr just added) — blending words like 'bricks' and 'brings'.
